description: Branch R-PRESERVE-1 no-op open / R-FMT-1 reopen (ACCDB). A copy of the fixture is opened read/write, one element at a time, closed, and its whole-file hash and size kept after each step: (1) open and close; (2) the same again, as a repeat; (3) open, enumerate TableDefs, fields and QueryDefs, close; (4) open, read all rows of T through a dynaset, close; (5) open, open T as a table, MoveFirst, Edit and CancelUpdate, close. Asks which of these leave the file bytes unchanged, and whether the answer repeats.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
